To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
multiple layers of foil can be used in place of litz wire for high-frequency power.

1) multiple layers of foil can be made to carry equal currents by interchanging the layer positions, 2) capacitance between foil layers provides ballast impedance that can balance current, 3) miniature transformers between foil layers can provide ballast impedance that balances current, 4) flux linkage can be balanced using spacing between foil layers, and 5) the best method for balancing current among foil layers is to use miniature transformers between layers.
the four strategies can be used to achieve current sharing in layered foils.
